title: Stop Saying "I'm Stuck": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for stuck? When you fall into a bin and can't get out, you're not just stuck. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Trapped: unable to get out
• Wedged in: stuck tight in a narrow space
• Can't break free: can't escape, however hard you try

Ever been in a spot like this?

Clip: The Battle of the Century (1927)
